Aq.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, brace, plank cap and stone footing finally read as built, but the untextured tan infill, panel thinness, flat-shaded grey placeholder boulder and shadowless flat lighting keep both sides well short of Palworld base-building finish and Valheim light.

Ra.bar_b_note: A's wolf matches the owner style bar (navy fur, violet lightning, white ruff, clearly taller than the ruler) but B's faint frames collapse into a white-and-black untextured body and its hit react is indistinguishable from standing, which sinks the set.

Sb.bar_b_note: The deep blue-grey translucent panel, pale borders and teal selection are on-brief and every list line now fits, but small text for a 7-inch screen, flat placeholder item icons and a mostly empty detail column read below Palworld's crafting UI finish.

Wv.bar_b_note: The elder villager's clear face and eyes, sculpted white hair and beard, warm green-and-brown costume and strong silhouette sit at stylised Palworld-NPC finish, carried by the model rather than by any lighting context.

Bz.bar_b_note: B's torn-down banners, wrecked crates, opened cage and smoke plume make the aftermaths read, but the smeared blurry ground textures, flat low-poly treelines, slab-like stone wall and flat noon light with no atmosphere are nowhere near Palworld or Valheim finish.

top_changes.change: Fix the creature faint/hit material and pose path (Ra B faint mid/end lose all fur material and turn white-black; hit react does not deform) so every state keeps the standing material and reads without a label.

Meadows ground and lighting pass for Aq/Bz: replace smeared ground textures with crisp grass/dirt detail, add directional sun shadows, aerial perspective fog and a warmer time-of-day grade, and swap the flat-shaded grey boulder for a textured rock.

Rebuild the homestead wall panel with real thickness and textured wattle/plank infill (B's frame, cap and footing are the right direction), and give each Bz site a unique aftermath prop instead of the repeated emblem stone.
